name: Setsugekka
message: 「……It's a shame to stop, but should we wrap it up soon?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, I guess so」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, let's enjoy the end――make it fun」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, let's do that――！」
<d0000>Murakumo Academy</d>――it's a school that specializes in teaching Jindou.
This is Sumiyoshi Academic Island, an artificial island floating in Osaka Bay. Its perimeter is about 10 kilometers, with commercial facilities and housing lined up around the academy.
I used to be a student at this academy too.

name: Iori
message: 「――It's been a while. Coming back here, too」
Well-maintained tiled paths. Grand glass-walled buildings. None of it has changed since the days I attended.
From afar come the youthful voices of students competing against each other, along with a teacher's voice spurring them on.

name: Iori
message: 「This atmosphere really is nice, isn't it」
Remembering my younger self brings on a wave of nostalgia.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, where should I head？」
Accessing the academy's management system with a guest account.
Then, a three-dimensional <d0001>HR</d>≪Holographic Reality≫ projection appears in midair.
Operating the central management system to search where the person I'm looking for is—their name was, let's see――

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, found 'em. The medical room, huh」
When I enter the room, lively voices reach my ears.

name: Female Student A
message: 「Doctor…… it hurts, it hurts so baaad～」

name: Female Student B
message: 「Please, Doctor, please save her life！」
A girl in academy uniform holds the hand of a girl lying on a bed, crying boohoo.
「Tch, stop being so dramatic, you idiots！」
「Don't shriek like a bunch of whiny birds just because you got hit on the arm a little. There's nothing wrong with the bone, it's just internal bruising」
「Something like this will heal right up if you slap a compress on it！」
A female doctor slaps a cooling compress right onto the girl's reddened arm.

name: Iori
message: 「Um, is this Doctor Sasaki？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, I am. Who are you」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm Muragaki Iori of the <d0004>Tenju</d> Special Division. I'll be working with you starting today」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh—right, it was starting from today」
She rakes a hand roughly through her hair and turns a look of pure bother my way.

name: Mikoto
message: 「As you can see, I'm tied up right now. Outside good?」
Leaving the students inside, I step out into the hallway with Dr. Sasaki.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Alright then. I'm Sasaki Mikoto, nice to meet you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, please treat me well！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Too loud…… This isn't the military, talk at a normal volume.」
Oops, my usual habit slipped out without me thinking.

name: Mikoto
message: 「I hear you're currently in the JGSDF's <d0002>Tenju Special Forces Group "Musashi"</d>. I've heard all sorts of rumors, you know？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Word is it's a special unit that carries Origami and wields Tenju, packed with monsters a match for a thousand men each—is that true？」
Spirit―style mechanical blade―<d0003>Origami</d>.
Origami is a variant of a spirit blade that controls a metal called Tamahagane—which houses myriad gods—using spirit-style mechanical parts.
This special power drawn from Origami is called "Tenju."
Through the power of Tenju, a swordsman can deploy a barrier field to block bullets and cleave steel with a blade.
Furthermore, with Tenju, a swordsman also achieves major physical enhancement, higher speed, and heightened five senses.
Therefore, in close-quarters combat, they display performance far surpassing ordinary soldiers.

name: Iori
message: 「Calling everyone monsters is a bit much, isn't it. Only a very few among the unit can hold their own against a battalion-scale response.」

name: Iori
message: 「For the other members, <d0005>company-scale</d> is about the limit.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Nah, to an ordinary person, that's already plenty monstrous……」

name: Iori
message: 「There are always people higher up, though. Like "Akegarasu," for instance.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You mean that special unit made up only of <d0078>Ikusabito</d> who carry spirit blades? I hear the name a lot, though what they actually are is even more of a mystery than "Musashi."」
Both "Musashi" and "Akegarasu" are fairly special organizations within the JGSDF, with both their members and their operations kept secret.
What I just mentioned is publicly known information so there's no problem, but there's little I can say about internal matters.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh well, either way there are no superiors at this academy. Let's take it easy.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You've heard about me, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sasaki Mikoto-san, age unknown. I've been informed that you're a specially appointed dispatched local collaborator, and in appearance a woman around thirty.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hey, what's with "in appearance a woman around thirty," correct that.」

name: Iori
message: 「S-sorry.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I'm clearly in my twenties, no matter how you look at me！ Right？！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「A young maiden in her prime is sensitive to even little comments like that, so watch it.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll keep that etched in my mind.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「So, how much have you heard about this 'errand'？」

name: Iori
message: 「Only that you want me to help out with academic duties at the academy.」
Because the nature of its operations is kept secret, the Tenju Special Forces can move around much more freely than other military branches.
Because of that, special appointment dispatches upon receiving requests for cooperation from outside—colloquially known as "errands"—happen frequently, just like this time.

name: Iori
message: 「I've been ordered from above to get the details from the local liaison—meaning you.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hmm...... I see, fair enough.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, look, it's nothing all that difficult. You just need to give me a little hand.」

name: Iori
message: 「A hand, you say？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I'm the school doctor, and at the same time, the homeroom teacher for a certain class.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I want you to step in as assistant homeroom teacher and instruct the students there.」

name: Iori
message: 「Aren't you going to instruct them yourself, Sasaki?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「As you can see, I'm no martial artist. So I can't give specialized instruction to students in the <d0006>Martial Arts Division</d>.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Thing is, there's nobody else suitable at the academy right now.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「So the call ended up going out to someone from the Tenju Special Forces who's skilled at handling Origami.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so that's how it is.」

name: Iori
message: 「That said, I have zero experience with teaching or academic duties. Will I be all right?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Aw, there are only four students, and they're all fun, cute girls, so you'll be fine.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Keep a warm, homelike vibe, have a good time getting along with them while you teach, and that's all it takes.」
Getting along with cute girls...... That actually sounds kind of nice to look forward to.

name: Iori
message: 「Do you have any concrete materials outlining the instructional policy or anything similar？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Nothing in particular. Do it however you like.」
Does that mean I can teach them in whatever direction I want?

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, we can worry about the fine details later.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「First, I want you to meet the students and get a feel for things. I'll send the students' profiles to your terminal later.」

name: Iori
message: 「Understood. In that case, Muragaki Iori is commencing the mission as of right now！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, I'm counting on you.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「So, normally I'd show you to the classroom and set up the introductions, but……」

name: Female Student A
message: 「Sensei…… are you done talking？」

name: Female Student B
message: 「I'd really like it if you treated me soon, too!」
The girls from earlier peek their faces out from the infirmary and stare intently at us.

name: Mikoto
message: 「So that's how it is. Sorry, but I want you to go by yourself. Can you handle it？」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course.」
It's not like I'm running a toddler's errand; I can manage at least that much.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh yeah, about the name of the class you'll be in charge of starting today.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「It's First-Year Special A-Class, ‘Takamura Class.’ Remember it.」
Today at 10:25 AM, I became a teacher at Murakumo Academy, and sub-homeroom teacher of Takamura Class.
